package rulefixtures

// scenario for filter_then_count_then_iterate: Same collection traversed multiple times for filter, count, and process steps.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func ExampleScenario350Negative(items []int) (int, int) {
	filtered := make([]int, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item > 0 {
			filtered = append(filtered, item)
		}
	}
	count := 0
	for range filtered {
		count++
	}
	sum := 0
	for _, item := range filtered {
		sum += item
	}
	return count, sum
}
